# Sana Sheikh — Writer and content marketer

URL: https://sanasheikh.in
Description: Long-form writing, newsletters and food writing. Mumbai.
Pages crawled: / · /about · /clips · /contact

"I write things people finish reading." Content marketing associate at Brightleaf in Mumbai. Links to 12 clips and to a newsletter on Substack.

Content marketer in Mumbai. B.A. English Literature, St. Xavier's College. Writes the Brightleaf blog and newsletter; before that, food features at The Daily Bowl.
